title: Proposed study collaboration on PTPN11-related disorders

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on PTPN11-related disorders
Dear RASopathies Network and Noonan Syndrome Association team, you both serve families affected by Noonan syndrome and related conditions.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would welcome your thoughts on a study idea.
Published work links Noonan-causing PTPN11 changes to gain of function, and metachondromatosis to loss of function.
For Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines a dominant-negative effect is proposed, but this is contested.
A recruiting observational study covers RASopathies, and the PATRAS and RASopathies Network registries may include PTPN11 families, though their pages do not name the gene.
The Baby MERIT trial is not yet recruiting and excludes variants causing multiple lentigines, and rapamycin evidence is preclinical only.
We would propose [study aim and design], shaped with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your registry or community might take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If this interests you, could we arrange a short call?
Thank you for your time and for your work with families.
